subject: Re: SDK bootcamp & local lab setup — next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-01-04T14:05:00Z
Subject: SDK bootcamp & local lab setup

Hi Ellen —

Thanks for the productive call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum for the pilot: 

What we covered (short):
- Target: embed Redwood inference for downstream clinical triage (embeddings + reranker) and a small tool-calling flow for structured claims enrichment.
- Constraints: most sensitive data will remain in their VPC/on-prem; they want a private deployment option for production.
- Success criteria: end-to-end local dev loop, one sample Python/TS app, embeddings quality check on your prompt set.

Recommended immediate actions (owner / ETA):
1) Provide sandbox access + onboarding packet (Redwood SDK + API key) — owner: Kimberly — ETA: 48h (I attached a short checklist).
2) Architect deep-dive: auth & routing options (API key vs OIDC; routing to private vs hosted models) — owner: Lumina + Redwood engineer deep-dive (we should schedule) — ETA: schedule this week.
3) Local quickstart: sample apps in Python + TypeScript, instructions for running with local mocks (scripted env vars, docker-compose dev kit) — owners: Karthik / Priyom — ETA: 5 business days.
4) Focus areas for deep-dive: embeddings config (dimensionality/quantization guidance), reranker wiring (scores + thresholds), and structured output + tool-calling examples (callouts for external API cadence).

Attachments: lab-infra-checklist.xlsx (sandbox checklist), redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip (sample apps + README).

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive: Thu 1/5 10am PT or Fri 1/6 11am PT — what works for Samir/engineers?

Thanks — we’ll put together the pre-call packet once you confirm a time.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>

Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2028-01-04T18:32:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK bootcamp & local lab setup

Kimberly —

Appreciate the recap. That matches our thinking. A few clarifications from our side:
- We care most about embeddings + rerank latency at 512 tokens and the ability to pin a reranker model that is quantized.
- For the deep-dive please include a short section on credential rotation and how audit logs look in the Private deployment. Compliance will want that.
- On-prem will be used for PII-heavy ingestion; for early dev we’re happy to use a hosted sandbox but need a clear migration path.

Samir (cc’d) will join the deep-dive and will bring our infra lead. Our preferred time is Fri 1/6 11am PT.

Also: please include a short sample of the structured output JSON schema you expect for the tool-calling flow (we want to validate against our downstream ETL).

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Park
Director, Platform Engineering
Lumina Health
ellen.park@luminahealth.com

Date: 2028-01-05T10:15:00Z
Subject: Internal: Lumina pilot — who owns what before Fri deep-dive

Folks —

Ellen confirmed Fri 1/6 11am PT for the tech deep-dive. High priority to have lightweight artifacts they can run locally ahead of the call. Please confirm ownership: 

- Karthik: local env + auth recipes — deliver a step-by-step runbook for both API-key-only quickstart and OIDC demo (use docker-compose + local mock server). Include short notes on routing policies for private vs hosted (how to toggle).
- Priyom: sample apps + structured output examples — build one Python sample (fastapi) and one TypeScript sample (nextjs/api route) that demonstrate: embeddings call -> index -> rerank call -> tool-call for enrichment. Include a minimal test harness with sample prompt set.
- Marissa: customer success items — onboarding steps and access flow; add the compliance asks (audit log sample) to the pre-call packet.

Deliverables by EOD Thu (1/5):
- repo (zipped) with README, runbook, and the lab-infra-checklist.xlsx
- short diagram (PNG) showing request routing for hosted vs private model variant

If any blockers (licenses, ephemeral hostnames, or infra quotas) flag them to me immediately. We should be armed with a short troubleshooting checklist for the call.

Thanks — I’ll stitch the materials into a single pre-call packet and send to Ellen/Samir.

-Kim

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@luminahealth.com>

Date: 2028-01-06T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK bootcamp & local lab setup — deep-dive packet + Friday 11am PT link

Ellen / Samir —

Thanks again — confirmed for Fri 1/6 11:00am PT. Below is the pre-call packet and quick runbook so your engineers can spin up the local dev loop before we join: 

Pre-call packet (summary):
- What we attached: redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip (sample Python + TS apps, README with env examples), lab-infra-checklist.xlsx, routing-diagram.png (see Drive link).
- Quickstart highlights (two commands):
  1) unzip redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip && cd redwood-sdk-quickstart/python && ./run_local.sh (this uses a local mock server for the Redwood runtime and an env sample .env.local).
  2) cd ../typescript && npm ci && npm run dev (nextjs sample with API route that demonstrates tool-calling).
- Auth options:
  - Quick dev: API key (rotate by env var, short TTL in the mock).
  - OIDC flow: sample config included for Okta + a small node sample that exchanges a token and calls the SDK with mTLS simulation.
- Embeddings/rerank notes:
  - Default embedding vector dim: 1536 (we include a small sample index builder).
  - Reranker: recommended quantized variant (4-bit) for production; we provide a fallback hosted model for early throughput testing.
- Structured output: included example schema (JSON) for the tool-call results and a small mapper script to convert the model output into our enrichment API payload.

Additional links:
- Dev Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDq-example-drive-link
- HubSpot deal: hubspot://deal/LP-2028-0391

Please find the attachments in this message. If your infra team wants us to pre-provision a short-lived Private deployment for validation, let us know approximate instance size and region and we’ll get an estimate to you.

See you Friday.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
